proposal.name: Keep all of an issue in its plan

plan.name: Keep all of an issue in its plan
plan.summary: Require a plumbing plan to cover its whole issue; when it cannot fit one reviewable pull request, the planner instead writes issues.json with a plan of issues covering all the work, using the existing format and validation rules. Teach the plumbing draft and check tool to accept that output, preserve it in the run artifacts and supply it on revision, and use the existing proposal, hash ratification and plan runner. Count an issue with a ratified plan of issues as merged for its parent only once a factory completion post names that plan's hash; without that post, unfinished or stopped child plans hold their parent, and completion propagates through nested plans. Update SPEC.md and README.md to describe whole-issue planning and nested completion, citing the applicable D-0105, D-0107, D-0147 and D-0122 decisions on changed SPEC bullets; the merger must record the new decision for this behavior. Keep ordinary plumbing plans, forks, the issue protocol, hash ratification, factory/plans and all ratified model statements unchanged.

tests.name: TestPlumbingDraftReturnsAPlanOfIssues
tests.says: A plumbing draft can return a validated plan of issues pinned by its hash, retains its draft artifacts, and rejects invalid issue plans.

tests.name: TestPlumbingIssuePlanRevisionKeepsPreviousDraft
tests.says: Revising a plumbing issue's plan of issues gives the planner the previous issues.json and returns the revised plan under its new hash.

tests.name: TestPlumbingCheckValidatesIssuePlansWithinItsBudget
tests.says: The plumbing check tool validates issues.json, logs failed and successful checks, and shares its check budget across calls.

tests.name: TestPlumbingDraftProposesAndRatifiesIssuePlan
tests.says: Solving a plumbing issue whose planner writes issues.json proposes the whole plan for hash ratification, then opens its first issue without building the parent.

tests.name: TestParentAdvancesOnlyForItsChildsRatifiedPlanCompletion
tests.says: A parent waits for a factory completion post matching its child's ratified plan, ignoring other hashes and other authors, then opens its next step once, including after a restart.

tests.name: TestUnfinishedAndStoppedChildPlansHoldTheirParent
tests.says: A child plan with work left holds its parent, including after a stop; a completed child plan lets its parent continue.

tests.name: TestPlansNestedTwoDeepFinishThroughPolling
tests.says: Completion of a grandchild plan propagates through its child and parent on polls, opening each ratified step in order once and posting each plan's completion once.

usage.summary: Wrote `plan.json` and seven acceptance tests covering whole-issue planning, nested plan completion, and required SPEC/README updates. The first check passed: all seven tests fail on the base code, and `repo/` remains unchanged.
